description: Static stand-in for Storage's SP-1101 sealed write custody of DS15 originals (sweep part 2B, S-N2). stores: the write recipe each Storage instance's custody records per family; resource_manifests: the SHA-256 manifest of the frozen resources each family's originals were written against; sealed_originals: the binding (Storage instance, scope, Server, Project, event type, ids, owner operation, CV-339 commitment) and write recipe sealed at each original ref. Recorded once by scripts/pm_ds15_p2b_cases.py --write-custody; the case under check never adds to it. Native custody NOT_RUN.
